output.summary: A large, solitary palm native to the Canary Islands, it has a broad crown of feather-like leaves and a trunk made distinctive by pruning. Its yellow-orange fruit has edible pulp, although it is not considered a particularly good date. In the Canary Islands, its sap is made into palm syrup, produced only on La Gomera.
output.edibilityNote: The fruit pulp is edible but considered a poor date; in the Canary Islands, sap is made into syrup, produced only on La Gomera.
